name: ConsistencyLevel
docstring: A ConsistencyLevel instance specifies the consistency guarantee level for read operations on a collection.

values.name: ClStrong
values.description: = ConsistencyLevel(commonpb.ConsistencyLevel_Strong) Strong consistency. All operations are immediately visible.

values.name: ClBounded
values.description: = ConsistencyLevel(commonpb.ConsistencyLevel_Bounded) Bounded staleness with a default 5-second tolerance window.

values.name: ClSession
values.description: = ConsistencyLevel(commonpb.ConsistencyLevel_Session) Session consistency. Reads see writes from the same session.
